title: Products | House of Zen
description: Explore Premium Flower, Pre Rolls, Edibles, Concentrates, Topicals, CBD Products, Vaporizers and Accessories at House of Zen, family-run in Detroit.
lede: We carry a full selection of licensed cannabis products designed to meet every lifestyle and experience level.

items: Browse here. Each category page explains what the format is and how people choose among them. Take your time.
Order on the live menu. When you know what you would like, our live menu lists products by category, with in-store and curbside pickup. Please have your photo ID with you when you pick up.
Come in and ask. Visit us at 14501 Mack Ave, Detroit, or call (313) 332-1733. Our hours are Mon-Sun: 9 am to 9 pm.

blocks.html: For adults 21 and older. If this is your first time, our Dispensary Guide is a good place to begin.
